reporting-org.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre

description.narrative: Drilling groundwater wells – Rehabilitating main wells that supplied neighborhoods in affected cities – Providing water purification and desalination plants in schools and health centers – Providing water tankers to cover villages – Providing waste disposal baskets and establishing a recycling system
Providing potable water to local residents in affected areas, whether at the household level, schools, or health centers

Rehabilitating 7 groundwater wells, providing 250 plastic tanks with a capacity of 2,000 liters, providing 250 1-horsepower water pumps, providing 25 2-horsepower water pumps, providing 1,000 garbage collection baskets, purchasing and distributing 10,000 hygiene kits. Drilling 12 new wells, providing 32 water desalination units, and providing 3 water transport trucks.
